metadata.title: Jorge Díaz | Senior Frontend Developer
metadata.description: Portfolio of Jorge Díaz, a senior frontend developer based in Buenos Aires, Argentina, building web products with React, Next.js and TypeScript.

hero.intro: based in Buenos Aires, Argentina, with 5+ years of experience building and shipping web products with React, Next.js and TypeScript.

about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Get to know me!
about.paragraph1: I'm Jorge, a <bold>senior frontend developer</bold> based in Buenos Aires, Argentina, with <bold>5+ years</bold> of experience building web products end to end — from architecture and data modeling to the UI details that make software feel solid.
about.paragraph2: My day-to-day stack is <bold>TypeScript, React and Next.js</bold>, but I care less about a specific framework and more about shipping maintainable code: clear boundaries, sensible defaults, and enough tests that changes don't feel risky.
about.paragraph3: I come from a background in communication and marketing, which shapes how I work — I default to writing things down clearly, and I care about how a product reads to the person actually using it, not just how it's built underneath.
about.paragraph4: Outside of work I travel, watch way too many series, and go trekking whenever I get the chance.

cultureAtlas.name: The Culture Atlas
cultureAtlas.description: A digital culture atlas covering all 206 countries and territories in the world, presented as an interactive illustrated book with over 3,000 bilingual (ES/EN) stories, each paired with a hand-drawn SVG illustration. Fully static content architecture, a custom i18n layer, and a book-style page-turn carousel, backed by unit and end-to-end test coverage.

artrends.name: Artrends
artrends.description: Artrends is an app that aggregates and ranks the latest trends from various social media platforms in Argentina, including Twitter, Google, YouTube, Spotify, and news portals.

beerHouse.name: Beer House
beerHouse.description: BeerHouse is a full e-commerce platform built for a client specializing in imported beers, featuring a product catalog, shopping cart, special offers, user authentication, CMS-managed content, and Mercado Pago payment integration.
